name: GiftRocket – Ultimate Gift Cards for WooCommerce
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
GiftRocket is a complete WooCommerce gift card solution for online stores to sell, send, and manage digital gift cards.

Create gift cards with preset or custom amounts, personalized messages, scheduled delivery, professional PDF cards, QR codes, barcodes, PDF417, and digital wallet support.

Customers can receive gift cards by email, redeem them through WooCommerce Cart and Checkout, and check their gift card balance and transaction history.

GiftRocket also supports WooCommerce Blocks, HPOS, CSV migration, multilingual stores, and modern gift card management tools.

Live Demo | Documentation | Get GiftRocket Pro

Why WooCommerce store owners choose GiftRocket

  • Sell digital gift cards — Create dedicated gift card products with preset or custom amounts, recipient details, and personalized messages.
  • Create professional PDF gift cards — Generate downloadable or email PDF cards with custom designs, QR codes, barcodes, or PDF417.
  • Offer Apple Wallet & Google Wallet — Give customers convenient digital wallet passes through optional ePasscard integration.
  • Schedule gift card delivery — Let customers choose when a gift card should be delivered to the recipient.
  • Redeem like store credit — Customers can apply gift card codes on Cart and Checkout while unused balances remain available for later purchases.
  • Track balances and transactions — Customers can check gift card balance, status, expiry, wallet passes, and transaction history.
  • Manage gift cards from one dashboard — Search, filter, issue, edit, and manage gift cards from the WordPress admin.
  • Built for modern WooCommerce — Supports WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks, HPOS, classic shortcodes, and REST API features.
  • Import existing gift cards — Migrate gift card codes and balances from CSV files.
  • Multilingual and RTL ready — Compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, Polylang, and RTL languages.

Configure GiftRocket from GiftRocket → Gift Cards with dedicated settings for general options, gift card forms, PDF/email design, delivery, and wallet integration.

Create and sell WordPress gift cards

GiftRocket includes everything you need to start selling digital gift cards in WooCommerce.

  • Dedicated Gift Card product type
  • Preset amounts and custom amounts with minimum and maximum limits
  • Recipient name and email
  • Sender name and personalized greeting/message
  • Custom field labels and message length controls
  • Gift card design gallery with image backgrounds and solid and gradient layouts
  • Live gift card preview
  • Scheduled email delivery with date and time selection
  • Automatic scheduled delivery processing
  • PDF gift cards included in the free plugin
  • PDF customization with layouts, colors, typography, and styling controls
  • Optional QR code, barcode, and PDF417
  • Optional Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes through ePasscard
  • Redeem gift card codes on Cart and Checkout
  • Support for both classic WooCommerce and Cart/Checkout Blocks
  • Edit gift card details from the Cart when enabled
  • Apply gift cards to admin-created or edited orders
  • Purchaser My Account → Gift Cards
  • PDF download and wallet pass links from My Account when available
  • Per-product gift card expiry options
  • Optional checkout recipient flow using billing/shipping information
  • Multiple gift cards from one product page
  • Quantity limits per add-to-cart
  • Custom add-to-cart and shop loop button text
  • CSV import and migration
  • Fraud protection with rate limits and security logging
  • System status and feature overview
  • WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang compatibility
  • RTL support and translation-ready strings

PDF gift cards

Create professional gift card PDFs that customers can download or receive by email.

  • Custom PDF layouts
  • Custom colors and typography
  • Gift card recipient and sender details
  • Gift card code and balance information
  • QR code
  • Barcode
  • PDF417
  • Custom styling options
  • PDF delivery by email
  • Downloadable PDF from My Account

Apple Wallet & Google Wallet

Give customers a convenient way to keep their gift cards on their mobile devices.

GiftRocket supports optional Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes through the ePasscard service.

Customers can access available wallet passes from gift card emails and their My Account area.

Learn more about ePasscard

Gift card balance and redemption

GiftRocket manages gift cards as a reusable balance instead of a one-time coupon.

Customers can:

  • Redeem gift cards on Cart and Checkout
  • Use remaining balances on future purchases
  • Check their current balance
  • View transaction history
  • View expiry information
  • Access available wallet passes

Store owners can manage gift card balances, transactions, and issued cards from the GiftRocket dashboard.

GiftRocket Pro

GiftRocket Pro adds advanced tools for stores that need more control over gift cards, redemption, reporting, and automation.

Install the free GiftRocket plugin first, then install and activate GiftRocket Pro.

Pro features include:

  • Gift card balance top-up — Let customers recharge existing gift cards using dedicated top-up products or the [wallregi_topup] shortcode.
  • Checkout gift card editing — Edit gift card details at checkout using supported checkout methods.
  • Advanced balance and transaction lookup — Display gift card balance and transaction history with [wallregi_transactions].
  • Greeting message presets — Offer predefined greeting options for customers.
  • Partial redemption — Choose how much of a gift card balance to apply to an order.
  • Advanced order rules — Configure gift card limits and combined redemption rules.
  • Large CSV migration — Import up to 5,000 gift cards per file.
  • Liability reporting — Export outstanding gift card balances for accounting and reporting.
  • Expiry reminder emails — Automatically remind customers about upcoming gift card expiry dates.
  • WooCommerce REST API — Look up gift cards and transactions through supported REST API endpoints.
  • AI writing assistant — Generate staff copy and customer greetings using your own API key with supported AI providers.

Explore GiftRocket Pro

WooCommerce compatibility

GiftRocket is built specifically for WooCommerce.

  • Requires WooCommerce
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks
  • Compatible with classic WooCommerce Cart and Checkout
  • Compatible with High Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Guest-friendly gift card redemption
  • Gift cards are not locked to a single customer account
  • PHP 8.1+
  • Compatible with WPML
  • Compatible with Loco Translate
  • Compatible with Polylang
  • RTL-ready

Import and migration

Already have gift cards in another system?

Use GiftRocket → Import / Migrate (CSV) to migrate existing gift card codes and balances.

Free: up to 500 rows per file.

Pro: up to 5,000 rows per file.

This makes GiftRocket suitable for stores moving from another gift card system.

External services

GiftRocket can optionally connect to external services for specific features.

  • dompdf — bundled with GiftRocket and used to generate PDF gift cards on your server. Learn more
  • ePasscard — optional service used to generate Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes. Requires your own API key. Learn more
  • AI providers — optional Pro feature. Supported providers include OpenAI, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, and Anthropic. Your own API key is required.

Translations

GiftRocket is translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang.

For site owners

  1. Set Settings → General → Site Language.
  2. Use WPML, Loco Translate, Poedit, or translation files from the languages/ directory.
  3. Sample locales include Bengali (bn_BD) and Spanish (es_ES).

WordPress.org language packs

Community translations can be provided through translate.wordpress.org.

Until a language pack is available for your locale, use WPML, Loco Translate, Poedit, or the bundled translation files.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate GiftRocket from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Go to GiftRocket → Gift Cards.
  4. Review the General, Form, PDF/Email, Delivery, and Wallet settings.
  5. Go to Products → Add New.
  6. Select Gift Card from the Product data dropdown.
  7. Configure the gift card amount, recipient fields, design, delivery, and other options.
  8. Publish the product and start selling gift cards.

Optional:

Install GiftRocket Pro for advanced gift card management, reporting, expiry reminders, partial redemption, larger CSV imports, REST API tools, and AI features.
sections.faq:
Does GiftRocket require WooCommerce?

Yes. GiftRocket is built for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Can I sell digital gift cards, gift certificates, or gift vouchers?

Yes. GiftRocket lets you create Gift Card products with preset or custom amounts. Customers can send gift cards by email and optionally provide PDF or wallet versions.

Can I create PDF gift cards?

Yes. PDF gift cards are included in the free plugin. You can customize the PDF design and optionally add QR codes, barcodes, and PDF417.

Can customers schedule gift card delivery?

Yes. Customers can choose a future delivery date and time when scheduling is enabled. GiftRocket processes scheduled deliveries automatically in the background.

Does GiftRocket support Apple Wallet and Google Wallet?

Yes. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes are available through the optional ePasscard integration. Your own ePasscard API key is required.

How do customers redeem gift cards?

Customers enter their gift card code on the WooCommerce Cart or Checkout. Remaining balances can be used for future purchases according to your gift card settings.

Can customers use part of a gift card balance?

Yes. GiftRocket supports reusable gift card balances. Partial redemption controls are available in GiftRocket Pro.

Does GiftRocket work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. Gift card redemption is supported on WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks. Additional checkout editing features are available in Pro.

Is GiftRocket compatible with HPOS?

Yes. GiftRocket supports WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I import existing gift cards?

Yes. Use GiftRocket → Import / Migrate (CSV).

The free version supports up to 500 rows per file. GiftRocket Pro supports up to 5,000 rows per file.

Can I create and manage gift cards from the WordPress admin?

Yes. The GiftRocket dashboard lets store owners search, filter, issue, edit, and manage gift cards and their balances.

Can customers check their gift card balance?

Yes. Use the [wallregi_transactions] shortcode to display gift card balance and transaction history on any WordPress page.

Can buyers edit gift card information after adding it to the Cart?

Yes. Cart editing is available in the free plugin when enabled. Additional Checkout editing features are available in GiftRocket Pro.

Is GiftRocket compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang?

Yes. GiftRocket is translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang. The plugin uses standard WordPress gettext methods and includes RTL support.

Does GiftRocket include AI features?

AI writing assistance is available in GiftRocket Pro. Store owners provide their own API key for supported AI providers.

How is a GiftRocket gift card different from a WooCommerce coupon?

GiftRocket gift cards use a reusable balance system. Customers can spend part of the balance, keep the remaining balance, and view their transaction history. WooCommerce coupons use a different discount system.

1.1.1 (September 21, 2026)

  • New: Full compatibility with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang with localized JavaScript validation strings.
  • Update: Scheduled email delivery checks now run every 1 minute in the background.
  • Fix: Timezone display bug for scheduled deliveries in non-UTC site timezones.

1.1.0 (September 18, 2026)

  • New: Added [wallregi_transactions] shortcode for gift card balance and transaction history.
  • New: Added WPML and Loco Translate compatibility.
  • Fix: Scheduled delivery timezone handling.
  • Update: Improved admin settings persistence.

1.0.9 (September 16, 2026)

  • Fix: Improved compatibility with SendCloud and WooCommerce for PDF delivery and email notifications.

1.0.8 (September 11, 2026)

  • New: Added custom PDF design features and template placeholders.
  • New: Added email and SMS shortcodes for gift card messages and wallet pass links.
  • Fix: Improved gift card redemption, PDF rendering, scheduling, translations, and currency handling.
  • Update: Improved recipient phone field and scheduled delivery interface.

1.0.7 (August 20, 2026)

  • Fix: Resolved a backend critical issue.
  • Update: Improved frontend UI and welcome page.

1.0.6 (August 11, 2026)

  • New: Added hooks for customizing Gift Card single-page fields.
  • Fix: Improved greeting message character limits and frontend field display.
  • Update: Improved admin notices.
  • New: Added free setup notice for new users.

1.0.5 (August 7, 2026)

  • Fix: Resolved WooCommerce JavaScript deprecation issue.
  • Fix: Fixed database creation issues.
  • Change: Moved barcode and QR settings to a separate menu.
  • Change: Improved Gift Card Preview settings.
  • New: Added combined Barcode and QR display options.
  • New: Added Gift Card Preview logo and date options.

1.0.4 (August 4, 2026)

  • Fix: Improved PDF and email gift card design.
  • Fix: Improved Wallet integration configuration.
  • Fix: Improved number input usability.

1.0.3 (July 21, 2026)

  • Fix: Fixed gift card claim button on the Thank You page.
  • Update: Minor improvements and bug fixes.

1.0.2 (July 1, 2026)

  • Fix: Fixed WooCommerce dependency fatal error.
  • Fix: Improved plugin menu visibility when WooCommerce is inactive.
  • Update: Minor improvements and bug fixes.

1.0.1 (June 26, 2026)

  • Fix: Fixed gift card claim case-sensitivity issue.

1.0.0 (May 16, 2026)

  • New: Initial release of GiftRocket.
  • New: Gift Card product type with PDF/email delivery, scheduling, and Cart/Checkout redemption.
  • New: Fraud safeguards, ePasscard Wallet integration, and WooCommerce Blocks support.
  • New: GiftRocket admin hub with dashboard, settings, security log, and feature overview.
  • New: Optional billing/shipping recipient support during checkout.
  • New: RTL support and translation locale stubs.
  • New: GiftRocket Pro add-on with advanced gift card management, reporting, REST API, expiry reminders, partial redemption, and AI tools.
